item.title: Tadakano ~Tadashii Kanojo no Tsukurikata~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Snowflake Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2010-12-03
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ただかの～正しい彼女の作り方～
  • 英語名: Tadakano Tadashii Kanojo no Tsukurikata

あらすじ

Kazuya is in love with Wakana, his lifelong friend. He wants to tell her that he loves her, but he can’t…. One day, Yosuke, his close friend, and Wakana start dating…. Kazuya is really shocked to hear that…. “I have to change myself….” He remembers an old man he met before. His name is Taizo and he says he is a master of love romance. Though Kazuya doesn’t believe him, he visits his house….

あらすじ

Secret place… There is a comic club, but only two students, Yamato and Moe, belong to it. One day, they find a secret room and an old diary full of H things… Their relationship changes since then and they have sex in the secret room every day after school. Their demeanor grows bolder day by day and finally gets bolder than what is written in the diary…
